text_blocks.snippet: Stage 4 prostate cancer, also known as advanced or metastatic prostate cancer, signifies that the cancer has spread beyond the prostate gland to other parts of the body, such as the bones, lymph nodes, liver, or lungs. This stage is the most advanced form of the disease and is typically treated with systemic therapies like hormone therapy and chemotherapy, often in combination with radiation therapy.
